subject: Mapping the Odds Ratios from INLA-SPDE

messages.author: 7b6a676ab8188230
messages.subject: Mapping the Odds Ratios from INLA-SPDE
parts:
Hello, 

Sorry to ask this naive question - after implementing a spatial model using INLA-SPDE to predict prevalence at unsampled locations with a likelihood function specified as binomial. Just like the predicted prevalence, I was wondering if was possible to also derive and map the Odds Ratios from this model - is it sensible to exponentiate the estimates from res$summary.random$s$mean (as well as those from 0.0025 & 0.975quant)? 

model.formula <- y ~ 0 + b0 + temp + prec + elev + popl + f(s, model = spde.model) # here!

ptm <- proc.time()
res <- inla(model.formula, family = "binomial", Ntrials = numtrials,
                                                control.family = list(link = "logit"),
                                                data = inla.stack.data(stack.full),
                                                control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1, A = inla.stack.A(stack.full)))
proc.time() - ptm

Thank you very much.
Anwar.
